pageSection.heading: THE MINDS BEHIND WHAT'S NEXT.
paragraphs: DevFest Madurai brings together developers, creators, community hosts and technology experts for a full day of learning, collaboration and innovation on 12 December 2026 in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India.
Official speaker confirmations are in progress. Until confirmed speaker profiles are announced, all track slots below are displayed as verified announcement placeholders.
